fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("safetyMicroUsd", 0) > 0 && !context.Variables.ContainsKey("safetyLedgered"))">
            
            
            
            <set-variable name="safetyPayer" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payer", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "anonymous"))" />
            <set-variable name="safetyTier" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payerTier", context.Product?.Id ?? "none"))" />
            <set-variable name="safetySurface" value="@{
                var surface = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("safetyCheckedSurface", "");
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(surface) ? "model" : surface;
            }" />
            <set-variable name="safetyItem" value="@{
                var surface = (string)context.Variables["safetySurface"];
                var item = surface == "tool" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName", "")
                    : surface == "agent" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("agentId", "")
                    : context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "");
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(item) ? "unknown" : item;
            }" />
            
            
            
                @("Chargeback: " + (string)context.Variables["safetyPayer"] + " session " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("session", "no-session") + " safety content-safety (" + (string)context.Variables["safetySurface"] + " " + (string)context.Variables["safetyItem"] + (((bool)context.Variables["safetyBlocked"]) ? ", blocked" : "") + ") " + (int)context.Variables["safetyMicroUsd"] + " micro-USD")
                
                
                
                
                
                
                <metadata name="session" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("session", "no-session"))" />
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                <metadata name="via" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("via", "direct"))" />
                <metadata name="caller" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("caller", "unknown"))" />
                
                
                
                
                
                <metadata name="safetyRecords" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("safetyRecords", 0).ToString())" />
            
            
                
                
                
                
                <dimension name="Via" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("via", "direct"))" />
            
            
                @(((int)context.Variables["safetyMicroUsd"] / 1000000.0).ToString("0.000000"))
            
            
                
                    
                        
                        
                        
                        
                    
                    
                        llm-content-safety
                    
                    
                        content-blocked
